goal: Rust-own the public single-token F16 dense-projection ABI through the current-C base, ordered-chunks, and serial execution boundary without claiming multi-token BLAS, paired projection, Q8 cache, or route ownership.

semantics: current C resolves F16 weights through cuda_model_range_ptr and dispatches single-token projection to ordered-chunks by default
current C selects the single-token base kernel with DS4_CUDA_NO_ORDERED_F16_MATMUL and selects serial execution with DS4_CUDA_SERIAL_F16_MATMUL or DS4_CUDA_SERIAL_ROUTER
current C reserves multi-token projection for its cuBLAS or fallback path, which remains outside this Rust ABI leaf

implementation.weight_range_path: with_cached_abi_model_range resolves the live F16 model range before launching the Rust embedded projection kernel
implementation.owned_dispatch_boundary: single-token F16 projection owns base, ordered-chunks, and serial kernel selection
implementation.remaining_compute_boundary: multi-token BLAS, paired F16 projection, and Q8/F16 cache behavior remain unowned
implementation.linkage_requirement: the C-linked proof currently retains Rust exported and embedded kernels with --whole-archive

integration_risks: multi-token BLAS and paired F16 projection remain separate public-compute work
the public q8/f16 cache hook is still implemented only by the current C CUDA backend
production route promotion, whole-archive retention policy, and C CUDA removal remain pending
the generated embedded CUDA object still emits an executable-stack linker warning during C-linked staticlib proof
